correctness.rationale: PASS. If q divides b+1 then b=-1 mod q, giving zero residue for even palindromes, and odd L=2k+1 digit linear form 2 sum_{j<k} (-1)^j d_j +(-1)^k d_k. For Fourier character h=0 the sum is (b-1)b^k. For q even, character h=q/2 has only the center parity phase and gives (b-1)b^(k-1). Each remaining z with z^2 !=1 gives the exact independent-digit product (-1)^(k+1)(z+z^-1), and inversion recovers the printed all-residue law. The residue correction B_q(r) is 0 for q2, either 1-2/q or -2/q for odd q>=3, or 0,1-4/q,-4/q for even q>=4, strictly inside (-1,1). Leading-digit restriction and L=1 addressed separately. Independently enumerated 630 complete exact (b,q,L,r) residue profiles for b=2..12, all q|b+1 and L=1..5; formulas and strict error bound match. Finite tests are not the infinite proof.
